import asyncio
import random
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TypeAlias


Generator: TypeAlias = random.Random
StoredPath: TypeAlias = Path
Loop: TypeAlias = asyncio.SelectorEventLoop
Clock: TypeAlias = datetime


Generator()
StoredPath("state").read_text()
Loop().time()
Loop().create_connection(None, "localhost", 80)
Loop().subprocess_exec(None, "true")
Clock.now()
